title: The Key Put on the Wrong Hook
youtube_title: The Key Put on the Wrong Hook | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Ximena is tangled up with a key hung on the wrong hook and almost hides it. Ximena tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
